messages:
Alice: heads up — I kicked off a staging bring-up for model v3-lite-int4 (tag: v3-lite-2026-03). Planning a 2-phase promo: shadow in prod -> 0.5% canary -> ramp.

Ben: nice. what's the smoke matrix? latency / p95 / rouge? :eyes:

Alice: quick smoke: staging lat p95 +12ms, token cost -22% vs baseline (v3). Quality eval on our 1k smoke set: MRR delta -0.3% (within noise). No other regressions.

Carol: ran the A/B slice (seed: 42) on 0.5% prod slice this morning. Short summary: avg latency +15ms, tail +40ms on long-docs (>2k tokens). Small increase in repetition for code-gen prompts.

Ben: repetition concern — what's the slice weight? are longdocs over-indexed?

Carol: slice was 0.5% uniform. For longdocs subset it was 0.05% absolute but gave disproportionate tail signal.

Alice: propose gating rules:
- auto-fallback if token-cost savings <10% and quality delta <-1.0% (any primary metric)
- auto-holdback if p95 latency increase >30ms for any producer region
- manual review if hallucination signal (seq-level) >0.8

Ben: sounds reasonable. Can we add ephemeral throttle: if rollback happens, blacklist variant for 6h?

Evan: +1 to blacklist window. Also add circuit-breaker on error-rate >0.2%.

deploy-bot: deploy started: promo v3-lite-2026-03 -> canary 0.5% (id: canary-6123456789) :rocket:

Alice: incremental config I'm pushing to rollout service:
```
{
  "variant":"v3-lite-2026-03",
  "canary_pct":0.5,
  "metrics": {
    "unit_cost_savings": {"min":0.10},
    "primary_quality": {"delta_min":-0.01},
    "p95_latency_ms": {"max_increase":30}
  },
  "fallback_policy":"auto-fallback",
  "blacklist_hours":6
}
```

Ben: where do we record the A/B slices? add link to notebook?

Carol: added notebook -> https://notebooks.redwood/nb/6123-v3-lite-ab (contains sample diff plots + raw telemetry) :spiral_notepad:

Alice: reminder — include the "longdoc" long-tail slice in the watchlist. We should attach synthetic prompts that stress KV-cache.

Evan: running a quick KV-cache stress test now, will post results in thread.

deploy-bot: canary heatcheck complete, 30m window. pass: cost -21%, primary_quality delta -0.28%, p95 +18ms. no auto-fallback triggered.

Alice: ok let's hold at 0.5% for 6h and watch hallucination probes. if stable, ramp to 5% with same gating.

Ben: I'll alert infra to watch node saturation in eu-west1 :eyes: 

Carol: noted. will post hourly snapshots.

Evan: KV stress: throughput stable, mem footprint +6% on longcontext jobs, nothing alarming.

Alice: thanks. tagging @oncall for extra eyes over next 6h :thumbsup:
